title: Engine API: evaluate one recipe
description: POST body and reply of the engine API. The web app sends the form, the Kitchen Profile, the picked idea and the recipe the model wrote; the engine returns the Meal result with packs, macros and leftovers computed in code. No model call happens here.

profile.description: The user's Kitchen Profile. Omitted: the default profile (prompts/kitchen-profile.default.json).

products.description: Optional products the user saved (in their browser), at most one per food. A product is the only pack option for its food: its pack size replaces the typical packs, its price (when set) prices the line, and its label (per_100g, when set) replaces the nutrition table for that food. Foods with no product use typical packs and, with a country, estimated prices. The browser picks the product for the user's store (that store's product, else their no-store product), so the request never names a store. Rules the schema cannot express are checked in code (422): one product per food; sold_by per_unit needs units_per_pack and no pack_grams, the others need pack_grams and no units_per_pack; barcode is 8 to 14 digits; price_date is YYYY-MM-DD.

country.description: Optional country for estimated prices. "ES": every line without a product price gets an estimated pack price from Spain's average prices (MAPA household panel, data/open/prices/es.json); "CA": from Canada's average retail prices in CAD (Statistics Canada, data/open/prices/ca.json); "GB": from the UK's average prices in GBP (ONS, data/open/prices/gb.json); "US": from U.S. city average prices in USD (BLS, data/open/prices/us.json). Lines get price_source "estimate"; a product's price always wins. Omitted: no estimates and the reply is the same as before estimates existed.

region.description: Optional region inside the country, ISO 3166-2 (Spain: comunidad autonoma, e.g. "ES-MD"), only with a country (422 otherwise). Foods with a regional average price (MAPA region columns, data/open/prices/es.json regions) use it and their lines carry price_region; the other foods keep the national estimate. Omitted: national estimates only.

Product.description: One product the user saved for a food. food is the English food key of the pack line (line.food). For loose items (per_kg) pack_grams is the unit the store sells, e.g. 1000; for eggs (per_unit) units_per_pack is the eggs per box.

name.description: Product name as the user wrote it or as Open Food Facts gave it.

price_eur.description: Price of one pack (loose items: of one unit of pack_grams). Omitted: the line has no user price.

price_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, the day the user saw the price.

label_source.description: Where per_100g comes from: typed by the user, or filled by a barcode lookup on Open Food Facts (ODbL) and not edited since. The macro line source follows it (label or open_food_facts). Omitted: user.

Label.description: Nutrition per 100 g from the product label, as the user typed it or Open Food Facts gave it (EU labels: carbs already exclude fiber).
